description: Backend enablement for the mobile app: baseline commit of untracked files to be edited, shared contract additions, and the eight backward-compatible API changes A1-A8 (design.md §7), each with Jest specs and its own commit. Web behaviour with no X-Client-Platform header stays identical. Must land first: FEAT-003+ depend on the shared schemas and the A1/A7/A8 server behaviour.
steps: plan.md item 0: run `git ls-files --error-unmatch` over every file this FEAT edits; commit the pre-existing untracked ones UNCHANGED (auth.controller.ts, token.service.ts, token.service.spec.ts, data-request.service.ts, dpdp.worker.ts, engagement/notification.worker.ts, common/queue/queue.constants.ts, common/logger/logger.module.ts, checkout/checkout.controller.ts, cart/cart.controller.ts, packages/shared/src/constants.ts, scripts/deploy.ps1, .github/workflows/ci.yml) as `chore: track pre-existing files touched by the mobile work (unchanged)`.

plan.md item 1: in packages/shared/src/constants.ts add CLIENT_PLATFORM_HEADER='x-client-platform' and MOBILE_CLIENT_PLATFORM='mobile'; in schemas.ts add mobileRefreshSchema, mobileLogoutSchema, customerSummarySchema, mobileAuthResponseSchema, mobileRefreshResponseSchema (+ MobileAuthResponse, CustomerSummary types) verbatim from design §7 A1; add optional paymentMethod: z.enum(PAYMENT_METHODS) to checkoutPreviewSchema; move profilePatchSchema verbatim from apps/api/src/modules/identity/dto.ts into shared schemas.ts and import+re-export it from dto.ts. Extend schemas.test.ts. Run `pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build` so the api sees the new exports. Commit.

plan.md item 2 (A1): new apps/api/src/modules/identity/client-platform.ts (isMobileClient, readMobileRefreshToken, readMobileLogoutToken); auth.controller.ts gets @Req() on verifyOtp/register/google, a private deliver(), mobile branches in refresh/logout (body parsed in the handler, no @Body DTO); add 'req.body.refreshToken' to pino redact.paths in common/logger/logger.module.ts; new auth.controller.spec.ts with the six §7 A1 test groups. Commit.

plan.md item 3 (A2): TokenService.rotate customer-status check → revoke family + ForbiddenException('Account is blocked'); DataRequestService.processDeletion revokes the customer's unrevoked refresh tokens inside its $transaction; extend token.service.spec.ts makeFakePrisma with customer.findUnique; new data-request.service.spec.ts. Commit.

plan.md item 4 (A3): new apps/api/src/common/http/trust-proxy.ts (TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=1, configureTrustProxy) called in main.ts right after NestFactory.create; new trust-proxy.spec.ts using @nestjs/testing + supertest + ThrottlerModule limit 1 (four XFF assertions + control case). Commit.

plan.md item 5 (A4): CartService.removePurchased(customerId, variantIds) (active lines only, never creates a cart); call it in CheckoutService.place on the fresh COD path only and in PaymentService.markCaptured after the capture tx (inject CartService; Logger.warn on failure, non-fatal); extend cart.service.spec.ts and checkout.service.spec.ts (fake cart gets removePurchased jest.fn); new checkout/payment.service.spec.ts. Commit.

plan.md item 6 (A5): QUEUES.DPDP='dpdp'; DataRequestService enqueues to it; DpdpWorker listens on it and throws on unknown names; NotificationWorker injects QueueService and forwards legacy dpdp.* jobs to the dpdp queue; new dpdp.worker.spec.ts and engagement/notification.worker.spec.ts (mock bullmq Worker), extend data-request.service.spec.ts. Commit.

plan.md item 7 (A6): CheckoutController.preview passes dto.paymentMethod === 'cod' as isCod; new checkout.controller.spec.ts; service spec asserts codFee 3900 in breakup.codFee and grandTotal. Commit.

plan.md item 8 (A7): PaymentService.initiate atomic claim via payment.updateMany({where:{id,status:'created'},data:{status:'pending'}}); count 0 → {provider, clientConfig:{}}; revert on createOrder rejection (where status 'pending' AND providerOrderId null → 'created') and rethrow; follow-up update writes only providerOrderId. Extend payment.service.spec.ts (fake updateMany honours where; captured/pending/failed/refunded/partially_refunded untouched; created path; two concurrent initiate → one createOrder; rejection revert then success; COD unchanged) and checkout.controller.spec.ts (reused:true keeps captured/mock_1, createOrder never called). Commit.

plan.md item 9 (A8): @Public() @Post('items/:variantId/move-to-cart') in cart.controller.ts → saveForLater(ref, variantId, false); new cart/cart.controller.spec.ts (guest, Bearer, save-for-later still true). Commit. Then run the full backend gate.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm --filter @belzo/api typecheck`, `lint`, `test`, `build` pass, including the new specs auth.controller, data-request.service, trust-proxy, payment.service, dpdp.worker, notification.worker, checkout.controller, cart.controller
Existing api specs (token.service, checkout.service, cart.service, ...) still pass unchanged apart from the documented fake extensions
`git log --oneline` shows the baseline commit, the shared commit and one commit per A1-A8 change; no .env*, *.pem or .agents files committed
verification: pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test; pnpm --filter @belzo/shared typecheck; pnpm --filter @belzo/shared lint; pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build
pnpm --filter @belzo/api db:generate; pnpm --filter @belzo/api typecheck; pnpm --filter @belzo/api lint; pnpm --filter @belzo/api test; pnpm --filter @belzo/api build
pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck; pnpm --filter @belzo/web test (shared schema change must not break web)
findings: COMMITS (master, local only, not pushed): item0 0622608 chore: track pre-existing files touched by the mobile work (unchanged) [exactly the 13 baseline files; cart-context.ts and cart-checkout.module.ts are untracked but NOT edited, so left out]; item1 6206c86 feat(shared): mobile auth schemas, preview paymentMethod, shared profilePatchSchema; item2/A1 e61ffa5 feat(api): header-gated body refresh tokens for mobile clients; item3/A2 89ba8d0 fix(api): reject blocked customers on refresh; revoke tokens on DPDP deletion; item4/A3 dcd7fc0 fix(api): trust one proxy hop so throttling keys on the client IP; item5/A4 50f9801 fix(checkout): clear purchased cart lines after a successful order; item6/A5 d1ab6a0 fix(worker): give DPDP jobs their own queue; item7/A6 c282a2d feat(checkout): preview accepts paymentMethod for the COD fee; item8/A7 666775c fix(payments): idempotent initiate so replayed place calls never reset a captured payment; item9/A8 7c197f9 feat(cart): move-to-cart endpoint. `git diff --name-only 5690322..HEAD` = 32 paths, all under apps/api/src, packages/shared/src, scripts/deploy.ps1 (unchanged), .github/workflows/ci.yml (unchanged); no .env*, *.pem, .agents/, .kiro/, aidlc-docs/. VERIFICATION (all exit 0): shared test 221/221, typecheck, lint, build; api db:generate, typecheck, lint, test 37 suites / 373 tests, build; web typecheck, web test 9 suites / 132 tests. New api specs present and green: identity/auth.controller (19), identity/data-request.service, common/http/trust-proxy (3), checkout/payment.service, identity/dpdp.worker, engagement/notification.worker, checkout/checkout.controller, cart/cart.controller (3). EXPORTS FOR LATER FEATS (@belzo/shared): constants CLIENT_PLATFORM_HEADER='x-client-platform', MOBILE_CLIENT_PLATFORM='mobile'; schemas mobileRefreshSchema, mobileLogoutSchema, customerSummarySchema, mobileAuthResponseSchema, mobileRefreshResponseSchema, profilePatchSchema; types MobileAuthResponse, CustomerSummary (no separate MobileRefreshResponse type was in the design; use z.infer<typeof mobileRefreshResponseSchema> if needed); checkoutPreviewSchema now has optional paymentMethod: z.enum(PAYMENT_METHODS). apps/api/src/modules/identity/dto.ts re-exports profilePatchSchema from shared. API helpers: apps/api/src/modules/identity/client-platform.ts (isMobileClient, readMobileRefreshToken, readMobileLogoutToken); apps/api/src/common/http/trust-proxy.ts (TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=1, configureTrustProxy); CartService.removePurchased(customerId, variantIds): Promise<number>; QUEUES.DPDP='dpdp'. SERVER BEHAVIOUR: mobile (header X-Client-Platform: mobile, trimmed/case-insensitive, single value only) login/verify/register/google return {accessToken, expiresIn, refreshToken, customer} with no cookie; POST /auth/refresh body {refreshToken} -> {accessToken, expiresIn, refreshToken} (missing/invalid body -> ZodError 400); POST /auth/logout body {refreshToken?} -> {success:true}, never clears cookie. Rotation of a blocked/missing customer -> 403 'Account is blocked' + family revoked. PaymentService.initiate on any non-'created' payment returns {provider, clientConfig:{}} (so the controller's place response has payment.clientConfig = {} on reused keys). New route POST /cart/items/:variantId/move-to-cart (@Public, same identity rules as save-for-later). DEVIATIONS / NOTES: none from design. auth.controller deliver() is generic over the customer type (CustomerAuthService's CustomerSummary interface is not exported); web branches are the original statements verbatim. The pre-existing pricing-settings.service.spec.ts fake cart has no removePurchased, so one of its COD place cases now logs the non-fatal 'Cart clear failed ... removePurchased is not a function' warn; the spec is unchanged and passes (left untouched as unrelated). Git warns LF->CRLF on commit (autocrlf); harmless. packages/shared/dist was rebuilt (gitignored).
